description: Delivered 1971, loaned to the Royal Australian Navy and returned to the Army; in service with the Army Helicopter School at Oakey to 2005. Sold to the Australian Aviation Heritage Centre at Caboolture 08/2017 and mounted on a pole at the memorial park opposite the Bribie RSL in 08/2019. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
museum_name: Bribie Island Vietnam Veterans Memorial Park
